extDescription.message: Practice English by talking to yourself. AI feedback on what you said — works with Chrome's built-in AI, no API key required.

langChanged.message: 🌐 Language changed (applies from the next recording)

lockedWhileRec.message: You cannot switch tabs while recording

enHint.message: Press "▶ Start" and talk to yourself in English. Feedback appears when you stop.

enNoAi.message: No AI is available for feedback. Chrome's built-in AI is not supported on this device, so please add a Gemini API key in Settings.

enSetupNano.message: This device can use Chrome's built-in AI — no API key needed. Enable it once in Settings (downloads the model).

enParseError.message: Could not read the AI response. Please try again.

enNoPronunciation.message: Note: your audio is never sent to the AI, so pronunciation is not assessed. Only the text is reviewed.

enDoubtNote.message: This is what speech recognition heard. It is not counted as your mistake.

engineAuto.message: Auto (Gemini API if a key is set)

engineNote.message: On-device AI is free, needs no API key, and keeps everything on your device. Accuracy may be lower than the Gemini API.

engineNanoReady.message: On-device AI is available on this device

engineNanoDownload.message: On-device AI is supported (the model will be downloaded on first use)

engineNanoNo.message: On-device AI is not available on this device

engineDownloadDone.message: Download complete. On-device AI is ready

engineDownloadFail.message: Could not start the download (restart Chrome if it stalls):

langNote.message: The English variant used for speech recognition. Pick the one you usually study.

secApiKey.message: Gemini API key (optional, for higher accuracy)

apiKeyIntro.message: You can use this tool without any key, via on-device AI. Add a Gemini API key only if you want more accurate feedback.

linkGetKey.message: 🔗 Get an API key in Google Cloud Console

howToGetBody.message: Open Google Cloud Console → select or create a project → "Credentials" → "Create API key" → copy it into the field above → Save.

jpNoticeBody1.message: Free API keys issued through Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) may be rate-limited when accessed from Japan.

jpNoticeBody2.message: If that happens, set up a billing account in Google Cloud Console and issue the key there. Linking a billing account moves the project out of the free tier, so you are charged for what you use (typically well under a dollar a month for light use).

budgetNote.message: If you are worried about spending, you can set a budget alert in Google Cloud.

budgetLink.message: 🔗 How to set a budget alert

securityBody.message: Your API key is stored only inside your Chrome and is never sent to any external server. Please still keep the following in mind.

securityLi1.message: Do not share your API key with anyone

securityLi2.message: If it leaks, you can revoke it immediately in Google AI Studio

securityLi3.message: If you share this device with others, we recommend deleting the key after use

importError.message: Could not import. Choose a JSON file exported from this tool (or from Mamorukun).

dataNote.message: Export your practice history as a JSON file and import it elsewhere. Useful for moving to another computer, or migrating self-talk data from Mamorukun.

tierNanoTitle.message: 💻 On-device AI (Gemini Nano, no API key)

tierNanoBody.message: Feedback runs on Chrome's built-in AI. Free, no key, and what you said never leaves your device. Requirements: Chrome 138+, a computer with 16 GB RAM recommended. Downloads a ~4 GB model on first use.

tierGeminiTitle.message: ✨ Gemini API (with API key, higher accuracy)

tierGeminiBody.message: Feedback runs on Google's Gemini API. More accurate than on-device AI, and works on computers that don't support the built-in AI.

enterOrSaveFirst.message: Please enter or save an API key first

errDenied.message: This project is not allowed to access the Gemini API. Open the API key list in Google AI Studio and check the "Billing tier" column — if it says "Unavailable", no free tier has been assigned to the project. (Your API key itself is fine.)

errKeyInvalid.message: The API key is not valid. Copy the key again and paste it into the field above.
